title: Birchline ST-2 Side Table: Assembly Instructions
productSummary: A small two-shelf side table with a top panel, a shelf and four legs. These steps cover assembly and basic care.
difficultyReason: Five short steps with one hand tool; turning the table over needs a second person.
people: 1 person, 2 people for the last step

parts.name: Screw
parts.notes: Size not given in the source

warnings.text: Keep the screws (D) away from children. They are a choking hazard.
Do not stand on the table. See the product label for the shelf's maximum load.

steps.title: Lay the top face down
instructions: Put a soft cover on the floor, such as a carpet or the flattened box.
Lay top panel A on it, upside down, so it does not get scratched.

steps.title: Attach the first leg
instructions: Place one leg C in a corner hole of top panel A.
Fix it with screw D using Allen key E. Turn clockwise.

steps.title: Attach the other three legs
instructions: Repeat step 2 for the other three legs C.

steps.title: Tighten all screws
instructions: Tighten all screws D fully with Allen key E.

steps.title: Stand the table up
instructions: With two people, turn the table over and stand it on its legs.
Check that it does not wobble.
steps.caution: Use two people to turn the table over.

gaps.issue: The source has no step 4. Shelf B is in the parts list but no step says how or when to fit it.
gaps.suggestion: Check the pictures on the box or ask the seller before tightening the screws

gaps.issue: The source does not say how tight the screws should be.
gaps.suggestion: Tighten firmly by hand with the key; do not use a power drill unless the seller says so

figures.caption: Fitting a leg to the top panel

notes: Clean with a dry cloth. Do not use strong cleaners.
Check the screws every 3 months and re-tighten them.
